args.message: I calculated revenue as the sum of order amounts and grouped it by each customer's region and city. Two groups have no known region: Paris, and orders with neither a region nor a city. Together they make up their own region group (null), so their region shares are measured against that group's total of 1,193.30. Oslo shows up under both North and South because customers in both regions have that city.
